<description>
This is a draft implementation of Schnorr signature batch verification in blocks, put here for conceptual discussion, and collaborative benchmarking.

The `secp256k1` code is still under review itself, please spend some time giving feedback there if you can:
- [Batch module PR](https://github.com/bitcoin-core/secp256k1/pull/1134)
- [ecmult refactoring PR](https://github.com/bitcoin-core/secp256k1/pull/1789)

TODOs
- [ ] Batch taproot tweak verification as well
</description>

participants:
  Sjors (member): support; supportive of testing against recent Taproot-heavy blocks and offered to provide an assumeutxo snapshot
  0xB10C (member): objection; benchmarked IBD showing batch validation was slower than master
  willcl-ark (member): neutral; collaborated on benchmarks and noted lack of fallback mechanism in early WIP
  andrewtoth (member): objection; objected to shared batch mutex contention and suggested per-thread batches
  Eunovo (member): objection; pointed out shared batch lock contention, verification inside critical sections, and ignored pubkey parse return values
claims:
  c:1968590438 | Sjors (member) | 2024-02-28 | question | approach | clears with answer | accepted (fjahr explained the batching mechanism and Sjors confirmed it clarified things); author replied in c:1968923056, c:1968959800; accepted by c:1969001095: "That clarifies a lot, and should be documented :-)"
    question: how batches are collected up to max_batch_size before calling batch.Verify()
    quote: "Is the current PR already using batches? It's unclear to me by glancing over validation.cpp if and how it's collecting up to max_batch_size{106} signatures before calling batch.Verify()."
  c:1968590438#2 | Sjors (member) | 2024-02-28 | suggestion | interface | clears with answer | answered (fjahr agreed and considered adding a startup argument or compiler flag); author replied in c:1968923056; answered by c:1968923056: "Yeah, I have been thinking that or maybe even a compiler argument"
    request: add a -schnorrbatchverify startup argument so more people can try it
    quote: "Maybe add a `-schnorrbatchverify` startup argument so more people can try it once it gets through review."
  c:1969001095 | Sjors (member) | 2024-02-28 | suggestion | maintenance | clears with answer | open; no author reply
    request: document how batch verification and signature collection works
    quote: "That clarifies a lot, and should be documented :-)"
  c:2106968575 | 0xB10C (member) | 2024-05-13 | objection | approach | clears with change | fixed (author implemented optimizations including batch per thread and verification outside critical sections); author replied in c:2889288127; fixed by c:2889288127: "I have implemented this and see a performance boost from it for the case with 15 worker threads"
    harm: batch validation caused significant performance regressions during IBD compared to master
    quote: "master is currently faster... after taproot activation, batch validation is significantly slower than non-batch validation"
  c:2525335080 | andrewtoth (member) | 2024-12-07 | objection | approach | clears with change | fixed (author implemented per-thread batches verified at the end of block checks); author replied in rc:2004525996, rc:2009282526; fixed by rc:2009282526: "I have now implemented it with a batch per thread using a flag set in complete as you suggested."
    harm: holding a shared batch mutex during addition and verifying on the main thread negated multithreading benefits
    quote: "m_batch_mutex is held for the entirety of adding, which will cause lock contention. Verify is then a blocking call on the main thread, which negates the multithreading."
  rc:1997877541 | Eunovo (member) | 2025-03-17 | objection | approach | clears with change | fixed (author implemented per-thread batches); author replied in rc:2004525996, rc:2009282526; fixed by rc:2009282526: "I have now implemented it with a batch per thread using a flag set in complete as you suggested."
    harm: sharing a single batch across threads caused worker threads to block waiting for batch access
    quote: "All the threads still share this batch. That means we still have the same locking problem; threads will be stuck waiting for the batch to be free."
  c:2851542917 | Eunovo (member) | 2025-05-05 | objection | approach | clears with change | fixed (author moved batch verification outside the critical section and benchmarked speedup); author replied in c:2889288127; fixed by c:2965616244: "It seems like the major reason for performance drop was the batch-verification work being performed in the critical sect"
    harm: performing batch verification inside the critical section caused throughput to degrade as thread count increased
    quote: "Doing batch-verification work within the critical section"

    harm: discarding the return value of pubkey parsing risks ignoring invalid public keys
    quote: "why discard the return value of secp256k1_xonly_pubkey_parse()?"
